raw_text: Root Maven parent aggregates ecommerce-common and services: user-service, product-service, inventory-service, cart-service, order-service, payment-service, shipping-service. Layout: `<module>/src/main/java`, `<module>/src/main/resources` (`application.yml`), tests `<module>/src/test/java`; root `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`. Prereqs: Java 21, Maven 3.9+, Docker. Commands: `mvn clean package`; `mvn -pl user-service -am package`; `mvn -pl user-service spring-boot:run`; `java -jar user-service/target/user-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`; `docker compose up --build`; tests `mvn test`; `mvn -pl order-service test`. Use 4-space Java formatting, one public class/file. Packages `com.example.ecommerce.<service>`; subpackages `controller`, `entity`, `repository`, `service`. Controllers `UserController`, mapped `/api/...`; entities `User`, `OrderItem`; repository `UserRepository` (Spring Data JPA). Variables/methods `lowerCamelCase`; constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`. Prefer Lombok (`<REDACTED_USER>`, `<REDACTED_USER>`, etc.) where already used; reuse `ecommerce-common` types such as `ApiResponse`. No
